system.name: Octavius
system.one_liner: Multimodal LLM framework that pairs a frozen LLM with LoRA-MoE experts to reduce task interference across 2D and 3D vision-language tasks.

content.variant_note: a dashed architecture box is the hub; four real-example task cards and a pill list of further tasks hang off its edges on short connectors
content.argues: One multimodal LLM, a frozen backbone with trainable LoRA-MoE experts and a 2D or 3D encoder, handles 2D and 3D vision-language tasks and plain language tasks.
content.subject: Architecture box (encoders, token strips, frozen LLM plus LoRA-MoE) ringed by four example task cards and a list of further tasks.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the architecture as a dashed hub and hang one colour-keyed, tabbed card per task off its edges, each card pairing a real input with question and response text whose object words are coloured like the boxes in the picture. Keep the frozen/trainable key (snowflake, flame) inside the hub.
lessons.suits: General-purpose multimodal or multi-task models whose Figure 1 must show both the unified design and the breadth of tasks on real examples.

evidence: Octavius is a unified, multimodal large language model with a novel capability to comprehend various tasks across different modalities
Octavius can successfully address various 2D/3D vision and language tasks
we combine the well-known Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and one of the representative PEFT techniques, i.e., LoRA

summary: Octavius is a multimodal large language model that attacks task interference by pairing a frozen LLM with LoRA-MoE, a set of trainable LoRA experts added to its output. Figure 1 is a teaser built around a dashed architecture box: a 2D or 3D encoder (both frozen, snowflake icons) turns an RGB image or point cloud into visual tokens that sit between system-prompt and query tokens, and the sequence passes the frozen LLM plus the LoRA experts (flame icons) to give response tokens. Four colour-keyed cards hang off the box: 2D detection, 3D captioning, 2D captioning and 3D VQA, each with a real photo or 3D scene and question/response text whose object words are coloured to match boxes in the picture. A pill list adds language tasks and more.
summary_zh: Octavius 在冻结的大语言模型旁加入可训练的 LoRA-MoE 专家，缓解多模态任务间的干扰。图 1 以虚线架构框为中心：2D/3D 编码器、令牌条、LLM 与 LoRA 专家，四张彩色任务卡附有真实问答文本，另有其他任务列表。
notes: The prior pass listed contribution-mosaic as a third kind; left out because the cards are tied to the hub by connectors and the architecture is drawn in full. The digest counts only three large bitmaps although four photo-like pictures are visible; not resolved. No arrows are drawn between the token strips and the LLM row or the output strip (stacking only). Flame and snowflake icons are bitmaps by the digest's small image sizes; the cube is a vector.
